How to Pick a Vacation Rental in Santa Cruz County
Santa Cruz (Westside / Eastside / Seabright): Best for walking to the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk, Steamer Lane surfing, local breweries, and downtown. HomeToGo | Vacation Rentals +2
Capitola: Best for a colorful, romantic, or family-friendly coastal village atmosphere with sandy beaches and boutique shopping. Vrbo +1
Aptos / La Selva Beach / Pajaro Dunes: Best for quieter, uncrowded stretches of sand, longer beach walks, and a more relaxed resort community feel. Kendall & Potter +1
Felton / Santa Cruz Mountains: Best if you prefer towering redwood trees, river views, and hiking over oceanfront fog. Expedia +1
Beach Access: Look for terms like "steps to the beach" or "oceanfront" if you want to skip driving and parking. Cozycozy +1
Parking: Santa Cruz coastal areas and Capitola have tight street parking; verify whether the rental includes a driveway, garage, or dedicated spot.
Pet Policy: If bringing a dog, filter specifically for pet-friendly properties, as many local rentals enforce strict no-pet rules. HomeToGo | Vacation Rentals +1
Weather & Outdoor Space: Fog is common in summer mornings along the immediate coast, so check for hot tubs, fire pits, or sunny back decks. HomeToGo | Vacation Rentals +1
Pricing & Seasons: Rates typically range from roughly $180 to over $900+ per night depending on size and location, with peak pricing and highest demand running from June through August. Off-peak months like December through February offer lower rates. Vrbo +2
Management vs. Peer-to-Peer: Booking through local property managers (such as Kendall & Potter or Beachnest) or verified platforms (Vrbo, Marriott Homes & Villas, Expedia) often provides 24/7 guest support. Beachnest Vacation Rentals +3
If you share your group size, preferred region (beach vs. redwoods), and travel dates, I can narrow down specific properties or search options for you.
